name: The Broken Construct
summary: A Windshaper asks you to report what you learned about the broken construct to Ayessa Dawnsinger. The High Order’s work with wind spirit magic has drawn concern.

sections.title: Return to Ayessa
sections.body: The Windshaper wants you to take what you learned to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar. The High Order has been testing the Windshapers’ patience by experimenting with wind spirit magic and touching knowledge under Windshaper purview. Ayessa can decide what should happen next.

sections.title: A Troubling Name
sections.body: Ayessa believes the High Order was responsible for the construct breaking down. She knows Belathaan as Valennia Stormfist’s cousin, and says his mother was a Windshaper. His involvement leaves her disappointed, and she needs time to reflect.

faq.answer: Report what you learned to Ayessa Dawnsinger in Valanaar.

faq.q: Why are the Windshapers concerned about the High Order?
faq.answer: The High Order has been experimenting with wind spirit magic and meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, despite being forbidden to do so.
Ayessa believes the High Order was responsible for the construct breaking down.
Belathaan is Valennia Stormfist’s cousin, and his mother was a Windshaper.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Broken Construct
